    Daily-path evidence (T188/T194): the daily daemon on :13705 already
    serves the new asset — /scripts/fleet_selection.js → 200 and its sha256
    is byte-identical to `git show 8f25010:web/scripts/fleet_selection.js`
    (78812bae84d4…), and the served index.html carries the wiring (script tag
    at 1525, backgroundMayMove at 5713, resolveSelection at 5985). So no
    restart is owed. The one irreducible residual is criterion 1's
    "indefinitely": the owner opening two asides, selecting the second, and
    watching it stay — decidable only by them, on a hard reload.

    One thing you should not read as mine: `go test ./scripts/docratchet/...`
    at HEAD went RED once on TestRestartThrashPolicy (gate cde5b3e4,
    "changed build inside the window did not report waiting"). It is a flake
    in that test's timing, not a regression — GREEN at 244ef6c before my
    commit (71991bb7), GREEN at 8f25010 itself (9062a475), and GREEN at the
    identical HEAD worktree on retry (75a7deeb). My commit touches only web
    assets, the Makefile and embed.go, nothing the T218 ratchet reads. Filed
    as 🎯T442 rather than left as a retry habit — a ratchet that reds for
    reasons other than the code it guards trains readers to retry instead of
    read, which is how a real regression gets waved past.
